title: Resolved Structure of the Arp 220 Nuclei at λ ≈ 3 mm
question: What is the resolved continuum structure of the two Arp 220 nuclei at 3 mm, how much of it is dust vs plasma emission, and what does the compact western core imply about the luminosity source?

what.value: 33 GHz exponential-disk parameters and 6–33 GHz plasma spectral indices (-0.59 E, -0.61 W)

evidence.quote: $\mbox{$\alpha_{\rm p}$}= -0.59 \pm 0.08$ for E and $-0.61\pm 0.07$ for W from the 6–33 GHz measurements by (cite: Barcos-Munoz15)
using the dust emissivity index $\beta$ of $1.8\pm0.1$ in the Galactic plane (cite: Planck21)

recipe.method: Standard observatory calibration re-run with revised J1550+0527 flux model, extra flagging, phase-only self-cal
key_parameters: flagged DA45, DA65, DV20; 37 antennas remain

recipe.method: Power-law fit to off-line channels; define CDC1 and CDC2
Non-linear fits of complex visibilities per 30 MHz channel, averaged over nine CDC2 segments with inverse-variance weights
alpha = f_d alpha_d + (1-f_d) alpha_p solved for f_d
assumptions: alpha_d = 3.8 (optically thin dust, beta=1.8); alpha_p from 6–33 GHz

recipe.method: Fix plasma exponential disks scaled by (1-f_d), fit Gaussian dust component; image-domain subtraction for dust map
assumptions: all emission optically thin for subtraction

recipe.method: Optically thick Gaussian-temperature disk, L = pi r^2 sigma T^4 /(2 ln2), T_b = T_dust

evidence.quote: E$_1$ and W$_1$ have major axis FWHM of 88 mas (36 pc) and 50 mas (21 pc), respectively.
Their peak brightness temperatures are as high as 73 K in E$_1$ and 640 K in W$_1$.

answer_key.quantity: Dust fraction at 3 mm, E and W

evidence.quote: we obtain $\mbox{$f_{\rm d}$}= 0.13 \pm 0.04$ and $0.41 \pm 0.05$ for Arp 220 E and W, respectively.

evidence.loc: Bolometric Luminosity of the Compact Core in the Western Nucleus

evidence.quote: of $+1.2$ for the western nucleus and $0.0$ for the eastern nucleus with uncertainties about $\pm 0.2$

not_stated_but_needed: Image sizes, cell sizes, cleaning thresholds and masks

missing_for_reproduction: Custom IDL fitting code not released
score_reason: Public data and well-described fitting models with tables, but custom code, channel lists and imaging details are missing.
rediscovery_reason: Public data, numeric results, and recipe mostly clear, though some settings are missing.
